summary: Guest orders are not capped at $500
description: Risk signed off guest checkout on the basis of a $500 ceiling. There is no ceiling in the code; we took a $2,300 guest order last week and it charged back. Above $500 the shopper should be asked to create an account.
acceptance_criteria: A guest order over $500 is rejected before payment.
The shopper is offered account creation with the cart intact.
A signed-in shopper has no such limit.
